==Notes==
*Sarnia will not spawn when you have the quest [[Defend North Kryta Province]] active.
*Sarnia can be made nearly harmless if you bombard her with [[condition]]s - her [[AI]] will use Plague Touch every time she gets one, preventing her from ever attacking you. Consider using a [[minion]] army with several [[Jagged Horror]]s to achieve this.
